evidence: Modifies shared logging conventions across the codebase and refactors exception logging in src/util/exception.cpp.
rationale: Eliminates escaped newline clutter in log outputs following log sanitization changes and simplifies exception logging. Following PR 35833, multi-line formats like PrintExceptionContinue produced escaped '\x0a' clutter in logs, and trailing newlines required an awkward carve-out in log sanitization. While it improves log legibility and standardizes logging calls across utilities, it is a non-urgent code and log output cleanup.
